comments.author: @LifewaysTravel
comments.text: Benin is one of those places that leaves you with more questions than answers. 🇧🇯 What surprised you most about how people live here? I’d love to hear your thoughts and thank you for exploring Benin with us! 🌍

comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: The royal history of Abomey and the stilt village of Ganvié are incredible, but I’m just as interested in how people make a living there today. Imagine building your daily routine around the water! What would you find hardest about that life?

replies.author: @LifewaysTravel
replies.text: We appreciate the feedback and will definitely consider it for our future projects.
